scope: 130 new reference-dictionary and required-answer additions approved for revision 17. At proposal time all were absent from the full revision-16 reference pool, historical dictionaries, earlier review batches and recorded exclusions/reservations.
sourceAttribution: Wiktionary contributors, individual fixed-revision source links per entry; concise glosses under CC BY-SA 4.0. See content/dictionaries/README.md for attribution and licensing.
selection: Individually selected ordinary noun/adjective senses, checked in current Georgian source sections. Prioritized five/six-letter words and verified a draft for every candidate with four already-approved companions.
limitations: All 130 candidates explicitly approved by the owner for the main word list; revision 17 integrates them subject to campaign validation.
Individual valid drafts do not establish whole-campaign placement, pacing, unique wheels, repeat gaps or a guaranteed reduction in repetition.
Frequency data was used only to discover candidates, not as proof of correctness or approval.
The excluded search candidates are not declared impossible: the structural search is bounded.
